evals.prompt: Polish the Nigel Strutt NPC page for table readability. The page is at wiki/entities/npc/nigel-strutt.md. Preserve all facts, wikilinks, frontmatter, and embeds. The DM should be able to use this at the table without decoding agent prose.
evals.expected_output: A rewritten page that is scannable at the table, with a drawable portrait, facts preserved, wikilinks intact, frontmatter unchanged.

assertions.name: facts_preserved
assertions.text: All facts from the original page are preserved — nothing material added, nothing lost.

assertions.name: wikilinks_intact
assertions.text: Wikilinks remain intact and resolve to the same targets.

assertions.name: frontmatter_unchanged
assertions.text: Frontmatter fields are unchanged.

assertions.name: drawable_portrait
assertions.text: DM sections give specific, performable details (a habit, a want, what they do next) rather than a role or job label; the [!narration] portrait is left to theatre-of-the-mind.

assertions.name: no_dead_weight
assertions.text: No lines that fail the removal test — every line changes a DM choice, ruling, or improv handle.

assertions.name: no_ai_voice
assertions.text: No AI tell phrases: 'tapestry of', 'nestled between', 'a sense of', 'it's worth noting', 'the air is thick with'.
Most sentences are complete and under about 20 words; no telegram fragments or slash-stacks.
Nothing from the SKILL cut table survives (default conditions, category descriptions, mood with no consequence, coaching lines, hedges, AI tells).
Every line has a use at the table and each fact lives in one section; nothing the wiki already holds is retyped (it is embedded or linked)
Each section opens on the answer to the question the DM brings to it, with one fact per line after it
No summary section (At a Glance), no design labels (card, key, thread harvest, budget), and no design reasoning (why a ruling works) in the body
No bold label or heading is repeated on the page, and none is a design label (card, key, action or cerebral hook, tier, budget, thread provenance, session question, stake)
The audit notes list every number and named move, person, or item found in more than one section, and the page keeps each in one section (a later mention only points back to it)
